shortDefinition: A JSONLogic rule in Bureau that controls when a field or panel is shown.

children.text: visibleWhen attaches a JSONLogic expression to any field or panel. It evaluates current form values to decide if the UI should render that element.
Supports AND/OR/NOT, comparisons, set membership, and nested logic.
Works for date comparisons, role-based visibility, and multi-step flows.
Same pattern at field level and panel level.

seo.title: visibleWhen JSONLogic
seo.description: Definition of visibleWhen, Bureau's JSONLogic-driven visibility rule.
